field.name: consent_text
field.p: I agree to a lumbar puncture. The doctor explained why it is needed and the possible risks: headache after the procedure (lying flat and drinking fluids help), back pain at the needle site, and rarely bleeding, infection or nerve irritation.

field.name: consent_text
field.p: I agree to botulinum toxin injections. Possible side effects were explained: neck pain or stiffness, temporary drooping of the eyelid or eyebrow, and pain at the injection sites. The effect starts after about 2 weeks and lasts around 3 months.

field.name: consent_text
field.p: I agree to the nerve block injection. Possible risks: pain, bruising, temporary numbness or weakness, and rarely infection.
